title: Never let Character Pixels cap
body: Stamina **stops generating** at max (240 base). Spend before logging off — every overflow point is wasted. Set a phone reminder if needed.

title: City Stamina = pure Fons, weekly
body: City Stamina does **NOT** regen daily — it caps and resets every Monday. 1 Stamina = 1,000 Fons regardless of activity. Fastest = City Delivery. Best for Beetle Coins = Fishing (Lvl 10+).

title: Solid Dice = 100% featured at pity
body: Limited banner has **no 50/50** — every S at pity is the featured character. Save Solid Dice for Limited only. Board Modification at 70 raises S-rate to 19.59%.

title: Buy Arcs with Tri-Keys, don't roll
body: 25 Tri-Keys = any specific S-Class Arc. Direct purchase. Never blind-roll the Arc banner unless you're already at 25.

title: Chiz is fully free — never spend dice
body: Chiz unlocks via City Tycoon level rewards, **all 6 awakenings included**. She's the strongest free character — never pull for her.

title: Jiuyuan A2 = team heal pivot
body: If you own Jiuyuan, her A2 awakening turns her into a sub-healer. The single highest-value standard awakening in the game.

title: Anomaly Pilgrimage is THE bottleneck
body: 3 boss attempts/week, hard cap. Esper Skill materials drop only here. Missing a week = permanent skill upgrade delay.

title: Witch's House has no in-game reminder
body: 3 fortune draws/day, completely unmarked. Set a habit: open daily before Pixel runs. Treasure Hunts give Oracle Stones → milestone Annulith.

title: Don't farm Cartridges before Hunter Lv 30
body: S-rank Cartridges and Hard Rewind unlock at Lv 30. Earlier pieces become outdated. Don't upgrade past +5 without verifying sub-stats.

title: Don't buy Fons from Lost Exchange
body: The Fons rate is heavily inflated vs. pull value. Always prioritize Solid Dice → Fabricated Dice → Tri-Keys.

title: Realm of Greed scales with your level
body: Don't rush Mammon at low level — payout grows substantially as you level. Upgrade Blind Mammon weekly via Auction House (Gluttonous Eyes / Covetous Coins).

title: Build around the Esper Cycle, not rainbow
body: Random teams waste Esper Meter. Pick **neighboring elements** for Duo reactions, or full trios (Top: Lakshana+Cosmos+Anima → Charged; Bottom: Incantation+Chaos+Psyche → Discord).

title: Codes expire without warning
body: Redeem all current codes ASAP after a livestream or patch. Each gives ~50–100 Annulith on average. Settings → Redeem Code (after Episode 0).

title: Pink Paws Heist resets every 14 days
body: Not weekly! Track the cap counter in-game. Avoid combat (every HP loss costs Fons). Extract on the '!' marker.
